lines: I don't often drink beer
so you shouldn't value my opinion
SO MY KIDS WANT A PUPPY FOR CHRISTMAS
I USUALLY COOK A TURKEY, BUT WHATEVER MAKES THEM HAPPY
I DON'T DO MIDGET JOKES OFTEN
BUT WHEN I DO I KEEP THEM SHORT
I TRIED TO RE-MARRY MY EX WIFE
BUT SHE FIGURED OUT I WAS ONLY AFTER MY MONEY
GIVE A MAN A GUN AND HE WILL ROB A BANK
BUT GIVE A MAN A BANK AND HE WILL ROB THE WORLD
If I see one more person texting and driving
I'm gonna roll my window down and throw my beer at them
MY WIFE SAID SHE WANTED PEACE AND QUIET WHILE SHE COOKED DINNER
SO I TOOK THE BATTERY OUT OF THE SMOKE ALARM
HAVING COMMON SENSE IS NOT A GIFT, IT IS A PUNISHMENT
BECAUSE YOU HAVE TO DEAL WITH THE MAJORITY WHO DON'T HAVE ANY.
I DON'T ALWAYS CHECK THE TIME ON MY PHONE
BUT WHEN I DO, I HAVE TO LOOK IMMEDIATELY AGAIN BECAUSE I FORGOT WHAT TIME IT WAS
I DON'T ALWAYS SUBMIT MY MEMES TO IMGFLIP
BUT WHEN I DO, THEY NEVER GET MORE THAN 8 UPVOTES
MY WIFE HAS JUST BOUGHT HERSELF A SMART CAR. IT WON'T LET HER IN.
IF PRONOUNCING THE LETTER 'B' AS A 'V' MAKES ME RUSSIAN, THEN SOVIET.
FUNNY HOW DRINKING 8 CUPS OF WATER A DAY SEEMS IMPOSSIBLE
BUT 8 BEERS & 7 SHOTS IN THREE HOURS, GOES DOWN LIKE A FAT KID ON A SEESAW
ENGLISH IS A DIFFICULT LANGUAGE
IT CAN BE UNDERSTOOD THROUGH TOUGH THOROUGH THOUGHT, THOUGH
SCIENTISTS THINK THAT THE WORLD IS MADE UP OF NEUTRONS AND ELECTRONS THEY FORGOT MORONS
I DON'T ALWAYS REACH 250,000 POINTS ON IMGFLIP
BUT I DID TODAY! THANKS TO ALL YOU UPVOTING FLIPPERS
THE SINKING OF THE TITANIC
MUST HAVE BEEN A MIRACLE TO THE LOBSTERS IN THE KITCHEN
I MAY NOT ALWAYS AGREE WITH YOUR OPINION
BUT I RESPECT YOUR RIGHT TO MEME IT
I ALWAYS CARRY A PICTURE OF MY WIFE AND KIDS IN MY WALLET
IT HELPS REMIND ME WHY THERE'S NO MONEY IN IT
THERE ARE THREE THINGS THAT TELL THE TRUTH
SMALL CHILDREN, DRUNK PEOPLE, AND YOGA PANTS
